aka.zh: 济青南线（青岛至莱芜段）
胶州湾高速公路（青岛至黄岛段）

tagline.en: Across the Shandong hills, the Taihang, the Yellow River at Hukou and the Liupan mountains: a southern twin to G20, from Qingdao to Lanzhou
tagline.zh: 穿鲁中山区，越太行，经壶口跨黄河，钻六盘山——青银高速以南的又一条青岛西行通道

start.en: Xiazhuang interchange with the Qingdao–Yinchuan expressway (G20), Chengyang district, Qingdao — kilometre 0
start.zh: 山东省青岛市城阳区夏庄立交，接青银高速——零公里点

end.en: The former Lanzhou toll station at the north end of Tianshui Road, Chengguan district, Lanzhou
end.zh: 甘肃省兰州市城关区天水路北口，原兰州主线收费站

en: G22 is the sixth of the eighteen east–west lines in the national expressway plan. Chinese Wikipedia's chainage runs to 1,858 km; Gansu's transport department and English Wikipedia give 1,795 km. From Qingdao it runs round Jiaozhou Bay to Huangdao, then west through the hills of central Shandong by Zhucheng, Yishui, Yiyuan, Laiwu and Tai'an to Feicheng, Pingyin, Dong'e and Liaocheng. It crosses Hebei by Daming, Handan and Wu'an, climbs the Taihang at She county into Shanxi, and runs through Licheng, Changzhi, Anze, Linfen, Xiangning and Ji county to the Yellow River below the Hukou falls. In Shaanxi it passes Yichuan, Huanglong, Luochuan and Fu county, and in eastern Gansu Heshui, Qingcheng and Xifeng in Qingyang.

West of Changqingqiao it shares the Fuzhou–Yinchuan expressway (G70) through Jingchuan and Pingliang and into Ningxia, separates at Baijiagou, tunnels under the Liupan mountains to Longde, and re-enters Gansu at Jingning. From Huining it reaches Dingxi and shares the Lianyungang–Khorgas expressway (G30) for about 50 km before running into Lanzhou from the east. Shandong carries 521 km, Shanxi 335, Gansu 520 in two pieces, Hebei 214, Shaanxi 193 and Ningxia 75.
Between Qingdao and Laiwu it is the Jinan–Qingdao southern line, opened in 2007 as a six-lane relief road for the overloaded original Jinan–Qingdao expressway, now G20.
zh: G22 是国家高速公路网 18 条东西横线中的第 6 条。中文维基百科的里程至 1,858 公里；甘肃省交通运输厅和英文维基百科作 1,795 公里。它自青岛出发，绕胶州湾到黄岛，再向西穿过鲁中山区，经诸城、沂水、沂源、莱芜、泰安到肥城、平阴、东阿、聊城。此后经大名、邯郸、武安横穿河北，在涉县翻越太行山进入山西，经黎城、长治、安泽、临汾、乡宁、吉县，在壶口瀑布下游到达黄河。陕西境内经宜川、黄龙、洛川、富县，甘肃东部经庆阳的合水、庆城、西峰。
长庆桥以西与福银高速（G70）共线，经泾川、平凉进入宁夏，至白家沟分离，穿六盘山到隆德，在静宁重新进入甘肃。经会宁到定西，与连霍高速（G30）共线约 50 公里，自东面进入兰州。山东段 521 公里，山西段 335 公里，甘肃分东西两段共 520 公里，河北段 214 公里，陕西段 193 公里，宁夏段 75 公里。
青岛至莱芜段即「济青南线」，2007 年作为六车道复线通车，用以分流不堪重负的老济青高速（今 G20）。

en: The Liupanshan tunnel in Ningxia, 9,485 metres, is the longest expressway tunnel in China built above 2,000 metres, and was Ningxia's first twin-bore four-lane extra-long tunnel. Bored from October 2012 through weak mudstone with water inflows, gas and squeezing ground, it was holed through on 27 May 2015 and opened on 3 July 2016, cutting the crossing of the mountain from more than an hour to under fifteen minutes and 24 km shorter.

In Shanxi the 99 km Linfen–Ji county section runs through hill country with landslides, coal-mined voids and gas; bridges and tunnels make up 49.6% of it, and 5.5 km pass through the protected Shizitan Palaeolithic site. It ends on the Hukou Yellow River bridge, 757 metres long with 175-metre spans, whose 146-metre No. 3 pier was described as the tallest on the Yellow River.

The Jinan–Qingdao southern line crosses the central Shandong hills with four extra-large bridges, 77 large bridges and 21 tunnels, the longest over 4 km; it was the first expressway in Shandong over 300 km built to six lanes throughout. Among the last pieces built in Shandong, the Tai'an–Dong'e Yellow River bridge is 3.9 km long, a cable-stayed bridge with 140-metre towers and a 430-metre main span, the longest of its type over the Yellow River when it opened in 2019.
zh: 宁夏境内的六盘山隧道长 9,485 米，是我国海拔 2,000 米以上高原地区最长的高速公路隧道，也是宁夏第一条双线四车道特长隧道。隧道自 2012 年 10 月开工，穿越软弱泥岩，涌水、瓦斯、软岩大变形问题突出，2015 年 5 月 27 日贯通，2016 年 7 月 3 日通车。通车后翻越六盘山由一个多小时缩短至不到 15 分钟，路程缩短 24 公里。
山西临汾至吉县段长约 99 公里，穿越滑坡、采空区和高瓦斯地段，桥隧比达 49.6%，其中约 5.5 公里穿越国家重点文物保护单位柿子滩旧石器文化遗址。该段止于壶口黄河大桥，大桥全长 757 米，主跨 175 米，高 146 米的三号主墩被誉为黄河最高桥墩。
济青南线穿越鲁中山区，建有特大桥 4 座、大桥 77 座、隧道 21 条，最长的超过 4 公里；它是山东省首条全长超过 300 公里、全线双向六车道的高速公路。山东境内最后建成的工程之一——泰安至东阿段黄河特大桥全长 3.9 公里，为斜拉桥，主塔高 140 米，主跨 430 米，2019 年通车时是黄河上同类桥梁中跨径最大的一座。

en: The line was numbered in the 2005 national plan. The Jinan–Qingdao southern line opened on 22 December 2007, Qingdao to Laiwu being 233.6 km of it. In Gansu the 258 km Pingliang–Dingxi expressway, shared with G70, opened on 24 December 2009, then the longest expressway in the province; Shaanxi's 192 km opened on 10 November 2010.

Shanxi's Linfen–Ji county section opened on 23 August 2012 and the Hukou bridge across the Yellow River into Shaanxi on 30 December 2012. The 128 km from the Shaanxi line to Xifeng opened on 20 November 2013, completing the route in Gansu, and the Ningxia section with the Liupanshan tunnel on 3 July 2016.

Shandong's last gaps closed in 2019. The new line from Tai'an to Dong'e opened on 30 June 2019, and on 16 October 2019 the Dong'e–Liaocheng section and the Tai'an–Dong'e Yellow River bridge opened, completing G22 in Shandong. At the Qingdao end the road is now being widened; the eight-lane Nügukou bridge across the head of Jiaozhou Bay was joined on 30 October 2022.
zh: 该线编号来自 2005 年的国家高速公路网规划。济青南线于 2007 年 12 月 22 日通车，其中青岛至莱芜段长 233.6 公里。甘肃境内与 G70 共线的平凉至定西高速全长 258 公里，2009 年 12 月 24 日通车，是当时甘肃省最长的高速公路；陕西段 192 公里于 2010 年 11 月 10 日通车。
山西临汾至吉县段于 2012 年 8 月 23 日通车，跨黄河进入陕西的壶口黄河大桥于 2012 年 12 月 30 日通车。陕甘界至西峰 128 公里于 2013 年 11 月 20 日通车，甘肃境内全线贯通；宁夏段连同六盘山隧道于 2016 年 7 月 3 日通车。
山东境内最后的缺口于 2019 年打通。泰安至东阿段主线于 2019 年 6 月 30 日通车；10 月 16 日，东阿至聊城段与泰安至东阿段黄河特大桥通车，青兰高速山东段全线贯通。青岛端目前正在改扩建；跨越胶州湾顶端的八车道女姑口特大桥于 2022 年 10 月 30 日合龙。

en: No total has been published. The public section figures are 16.16 billion yuan for the 307.8 km Jinan–Qingdao southern line (2007, including the Jinan–Laiwu part that is not G22), 13.89 billion for Shaanxi's 192 km (2010), 9.17 billion estimated for Linfen–Ji county (2012) plus 170 million for the Hukou bridge, 8.90 billion for Leijiajiao–Xifeng (2013), 4.21 billion for the 50.3 km in Ningxia (2016) and 8.07 billion for the 86.55 km Dong'e–Liaocheng section (2019).

It is a toll road, built by the provinces and their companies. The one foreign loan found is the Asian Development Bank's US$300 million towards the Pingliang–Dingxi expressway, which G22 shares with G70. In Shandong the last sections were built by Qilu Transportation Development Group (Dong'e–Liaocheng) and Shandong Hi-Speed Group (the Yellow River bridge).
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。已公开的分段数字为：济青南线 307.8 公里概算 161.58 亿元（2007，含不属于 G22 的济南至莱芜段），陕西段 192 公里 138.9 亿元（2010），临汾至吉县段估算约 91.7 亿元（2012）另加壶口黄河大桥 1.7 亿元，雷家角至西峰段 88.97 亿元（2013），宁夏段 50.3 公里 42.07 亿元（2016），东阿至聊城段 86.55 公里概算 80.74 亿元（2019）。
它是收费公路，由沿线各省区及其公司建设。所查到的唯一一笔外国贷款，是亚洲开发银行为与 G70 共线的平定高速提供的 3 亿美元。山东境内最后两段分别由齐鲁交通发展集团（东阿至聊城段）和山东高速集团（黄河特大桥）投资建设。

en: On the Leijiajiao–Xifeng section in Gansu the limits are 120 km/h for cars and 100 for other vehicles, reduced to 80 or 60 in tunnels, on long descents and on the large bridges. The Ningxia section through the Liupan mountains was designed for 80 km/h.
zh: 甘肃雷家角至西峰段小客车最高限速每小时 120 公里，其他机动车 100 公里；隧道、特大桥、长下坡等路段限速 80 或 60 公里。宁夏六盘山段设计时速 80 公里。

why.en: No total has been published. G22 was built by six provinces between 2005 and 2019 as separately financed projects, several of them shared with other national routes; sourced section figures are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G22 于 2005 至 2019 年间由六个省区分别立项筹资建设，其中数段与其他国家高速共线；下列为有来源的分段数字。

value.en: Jinan–Qingdao southern line, 307.8 km: 16.158 billion yuan budgeted (2005–2007), of which the Qingdao–Laiwu part is G22. Dong'e–Liaocheng, 86.55 km: 8.074 billion budgeted (2016–2019).
value.zh: 济青南线 307.8 公里概算 161.58 亿元（2005—2007），其中青岛至莱芜段属 G22；东阿至聊城段 86.55 公里概算 80.74 亿元（2016—2019）。

figures.source: China Bus Network (chinabuses.com), December 2007, citing the Shandong Department of Communications; Dazhong Daily, 16 October 2019, via iqilu.com; China National Radio, 17 October 2019

value.en: Linfen–Ji county, 99 km: about 9.17 billion yuan estimated (2009–2012). Hukou Yellow River bridge: 170 million (2012). Shaanxi section, 192 km: 13.89 billion (opened 2010).
value.zh: 临汾至吉县段约 99 公里，估算总投资约 91.7 亿元（2009—2012）；壶口黄河大桥 1.7 亿元（2012）；陕西段 192 公里投资 138.9 亿元（2010 年通车）。

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 临汾—吉县高速公路 and 壶口黄河大桥; Xinhua, 10 November 2010, via gov.cn, archived

value.en: Leijiajiao–Xifeng, 128 km: 8.897 billion yuan budgeted (2010–2013). Pingliang–Dingxi, 258 km, shared with G70: 7.68 billion (2009). Dongshanpo–Maojiagou in Ningxia, 50.3 km: 4.207 billion (2012–2016), of which the Liupanshan tunnel was reported at 1.7 billion in 2015 and 2.172 billion in 2016.
value.zh: 雷家角至西峰段 128 公里概算 88.97 亿元（2010—2013）；与 G70 共线的平定高速 258 公里总投资 76.8 亿元（2009）；宁夏东山坡至毛家沟段 50.3 公里总投资 42.07 亿元（2012—2016），其中六盘山隧道 2015 年报道为 17 亿元、2016 年报道为 21.72 亿元。

figures.source: China Gansu Net (gscn.com.cn), 18 January 2016; Sina, 25 December 2009; China National Radio, 27 May 2015 and 3 July 2016; Tunnelling.cn, 27 June 2016

value.en: The provinces and their expressway companies, repaid from tolls; a US$300 million Asian Development Bank loan for the Pingliang–Dingxi section shared with G70; Qilu Transportation Development Group and Shandong Hi-Speed Group for the last Shandong sections.
value.zh: 沿线各省区及其高速公路公司出资，以通行费还贷；与 G70 共线的平定段利用亚洲开发银行贷款 3 亿美元；山东最后两段由齐鲁交通发展集团和山东高速集团投资。

figures.source: Sina, 25 December 2009; China National Radio, 17 October 2019

value.en: 1,858 km on the chainage table in Chinese Wikipedia; 1,795 km in Gansu transport department figures and English Wikipedia
value.zh: 中文维基百科里程表为 1,858 公里；甘肃省交通运输厅及英文维基百科作 1,795 公里

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 青岛—兰州高速公路; China News Service, 18 November 2013; English Wikipedia, G22 Qingdao–Lanzhou Expressway

timeline.en: The national expressway plan lists Qingdao–Lanzhou as G22, the sixth east–west line.
timeline.zh: 国家高速公路网规划将青岛至兰州列为 G22，为 18 条横线中的第 6 条。

timeline.en: The Jinan–Qingdao southern line opens on 22 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 22 日，济青南线通车。

timeline.en: The Pingliang–Dingxi expressway in Gansu opens on 24 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 24 日，甘肃平定高速通车。

timeline.en: The 192 km Shaanxi section opens on 10 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 10 日，陕西段 192 公里通车。

timeline.en: Linfen–Ji county opens on 23 August and the Hukou Yellow River bridge on 30 December.
timeline.zh: 8 月 23 日临吉高速通车；12 月 30 日壶口黄河大桥通车。

timeline.en: Leijiajiao–Xifeng opens on 20 November, completing the route in Gansu.
timeline.zh: 11 月 20 日，雷西高速通车，甘肃境内全线贯通。

timeline.en: The Liupanshan tunnel is holed through on 27 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 27 日，六盘山隧道全线贯通。

timeline.en: The Ningxia section opens on 3 July.
Tai'an–Dong'e opens on 30 June; Dong'e–Liaocheng and the Yellow River bridge open on 16 October, completing Shandong.
timeline.zh: 6 月 30 日泰安至东阿段通车；10 月 16 日东阿至聊城段及黄河特大桥通车，山东段全线贯通。

timeline.en: The eight-lane Nügukou bridge on the Qingdao widening is joined on 30 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 30 日，青岛段改扩建女姑口特大桥合龙。
